for tid in text_ids:
    try:
        r=apis.phone.delete_text_message(access_token=token, text_message_id=tid)
        results_text.append((tid,'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        results_text.append((tid,'fail',str(e)))

results_voice=[]
for vid in voice_ids:

        r=apis.phone.delete_voice_message(access_token=token, voice_message_id=vid)
